## 30000 - 30043

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="30000">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />30000 PROD - Imported product base density does not match FLOWCAL product</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="30000">

This validation and exception applies on import of liquid meter data and tickets.

FLOWCAL will compare the Base Density value defined for the Product on the import file (Liquid Product Tab on CFX and TFX) to the Base Density value on the Characteristic tab for the product. If the values differ, then this exception will be generated.

For example, the Base Density for Product “Demeth” is set to 0.6500 on the Liquid Product tab of a CFX File. The product “Demeth” is configured with a Base Density of 0.6501 in the Product Editor within FLOWCAL. The value for Base Density differs between the import file and the Product, so this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="30001">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />30001 PROD - Imported EVP does not match FLOWCAL product</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="30001">

This validation and exception applies on import of liquid meter data and tickets.

FLOWCAL will compare the EVP value defined for the Product on the import file (Liquid Product Tab on CFX and TFX) to the EVP value on the Characteristic tab for the product. If the values differ, then this exception will be generated.

For example, the EVP for Product “Demeth” is set to 500 on the Liquid Product tab of a CFX File. The product “Demeth” is configured with an EVP of 515 in the Product Editor within FLOWCAL. The value for EVP differs between the import file and the Product, so this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="30002">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />30002 PROD - Imported table type does not match FLOWCAL product</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="30002">

This validation and exception applies on import of liquid meter data and tickets. This exception is only valid for certain products that require specifying a Table Type, such as products set to use Product Table Aromatics & Cyclohexane (2004).

FLOWCAL will compare the Table Type defined for the Product on the import file (Liquid Product Tab on CFX and TFX) to the Table Type on the Characteristic tab for the product. If the Table Type differs, then this exception will be generated.

For example, the Table Type for Product “Benzene” is set to Cumene on the Liquid Product tab of a CFX File. The product “Benzene” is configured with a Table Type of Benzene in the Product Editor within FLOWCAL. The Table Type differs between the import file and the Product, so this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="30003">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />30003 PROD - Imported table index does not match FLOWCAL product</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="30003">

This validation and exception applies on import of liquid meter data and tickets.

FLOWCAL will compare the Calculation Table defined for the Product on the import file (Liquid Product Tab on CFX and TFX) to the Calculation Table on the Characteristic tab for the product. If the Calculation Table differs, then this exception will be generated.

For example, the Table for Product “Crude” is set to Table A – Crude Oil (1980) on the Liquid Product tab of a CFX File. The product “Crude” is configured with a Table of Table A – Crude Oil (2004) in the Product Editor within FLOWCAL. The Table Type differs between the import file and the Product, so this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="30004">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />30004 PROD - Imported coefficient of thermal expansion does not match FLOWCAL product</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="30004">

This validation and exception applies on import of liquid meter data and tickets. This exception is only valid for certain products that require specifying a coefficient of thermal expansion (alpha), such as products set to use Product Table C – Special Applications (1980 or 2004).

FLOWCAL will compare the Alpha defined for the Product on the import file (Liquid Product Tab on CFX and TFX) to the Alpha on the Characteristic tab for the product. If the values differ, then this exception will be generated.

For example, the Alpha for Product “MTBE” is set to 788.0×10-6 on the Liquid Product tab of a CFX File. The product “MTBE” is configured with an Alpha of 789.0×10-6 in the Product Editor within FLOWCAL. The value for Alpha differs between the import file and the Product, so this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="30005">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />30005 PROD - Imported base density unit does not match FLOWCAL product</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="30005">

This validation and exception applies on import of liquid meter data and tickets.

FLOWCAL will compare the Base Density Unit value defined for the Product on the import file (Liquid Product Tab on CFX and TFX) to the Base Density Unit value on the Characteristic tab for the product. If the values differ, then this exception will be generated.

For example, the Base Density Unit for Product “Demeth” is set to Relative Density on the Liquid Product tab of a CFX File. The product “Demeth” is configured with a Base Density Unit of g/cc in the Product Editor within FLOWCAL. The value for Base Density differs between the import file and the Product, so this exception will be generated.

</div>

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />30007 PROD - Imported coefficient of thermal expansion unit does not match FLOWCAL product</a>

#### 30008 PROD - Base density unit not defined (deprecated)

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="30009">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />30009 PROD - High CO2</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="30009">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of liquid meter data and tickets.

FLOWCAL will compare the CO2 on a meter or ticket analysis record with the Max limit for CO2 on the Validations \> Product Spec. tab in the Product Editor for the product on that sample. If the value on the sample exceeds the Max limit for CO2 on the product, then this exception will be generated.

For example, the Max limit for CO2 is set to 0.025 for Liquid Volume % on the Product Demeth. A ticket is imported with the product Demeth that has CO2 Liquid Volume % = 0.0281, which is greater than the Max limit for CO2 on the product, so this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="30010">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />30010 PROD - Low CO2</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="30010">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of liquid meter data and tickets.

FLOWCAL will compare the CO2 on a meter or ticket analysis record with the Min limit for CO2 on the Validations \> Product Spec. tab in the Product Editor for the product on that sample. If the value on the sample falls below the Min Limit for CO2 on the product, then this exception will be generated.

This is not a realistic example, but for illustration purposes: The Min limit for CO2 is set to 0.01 for Liquid Volume % on the Product Demeth. A ticket is imported with the product Demeth that has CO2 Liquid Volume % = 0.0079, which is less than the Min limit for CO2 on the product, so this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="30011">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />30011 PROD - High C1, CO2 and N2</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="30011">

This validation and exception applies on import and edit of liquid meter data and tickets.

FLOWCAL will compare the summation of C1, CO2 and N2 on a meter or ticket analysis record with the Max limit for C1, CO2 and N2 on the Validations \> Product Spec. tab in the Product Editor for the product on that sample. If the value on the sample exceeds the Max limit for C1, CO2 and N2 on the product, then this exception will be generated.

For example, the Max limit for C1, CO2 and N2 is set to 1 for Liquid Volume % on the Product Demeth. A ticket is imported with the product Demeth that has the sum of CO2, N2, and C1 = 1.1396, which is greater than the Max limit for C1, CO2 and N2 on the product, so this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="30041">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />30041 PROD - Imported density engineering unit does not match FLOWCAL product</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="30041">

This validation and exception applies on import of liquid meter periodic records for meters that have the option “Import CFX Units” on the Imports tab in the Meter Editor set to Yes and the Product is configured with a Density Import Option of Engineering Units.

FLOWCAL will compare the Density Unit defined on the Configuration \> Units 2 tab on the CFX file to the Density Unit defined for the Engineering Units on the Characteristic tab for the product. If the Density Unit differs, then this exception will be generated.

For example, the Density Unit for Product “Propane” is set to REL on the Configuration \> Units 2 tab of a CFX File. The product “Propane” is configured with a Density Unit of Grams/CC in the Product Editor within FLOWCAL. The value for Density Unit differs between the import file and the Product, so this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="30042">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />30042 PROD - Imported density is undefined for API degrees specified on FLOWCAL product</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="30042">

This validation and exception applies on import of liquid meter periodic records where the Product is configured with a Density Import Option of API Degrees.

When the Density Import Option on a Product is set to API Degrees, FLOWCAL will import the Observed Density value from the Observed Density in API Degrees field in the History section of a CFX file. If this field is blank in the CFX file, then an Observed Density will not be imported and this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="30043">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />30043 PROD - Imported density is undefined for relative density specified on FLOWCAL product</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="30043">

This validation and exception applies on import of liquid meter periodic records where the Product is configured with a Density Import Option of Relative Density.

When the Density Import Option on a Product is set to Relative Density, FLOWCAL will import the Observed Density value from the Observed Density in Relative Density field in the History section of a CFX file. If this field is blank in the CFX file, then an Observed Density will not be imported and this exception will be generated.

</div>
